## Platform Overview

PullNova provides AI-powered tools for engineering teams:
- **AI Code Review**: Real-time PR analysis catching bugs, security issues, and performance regressions
- **CI/CD Intelligence**: Pipeline optimization, flaky test detection, intelligent caching
- **Security Scanning**: SAST/DAST analysis, OWASP Top 10 detection, secret scanning
- **Smart Refactoring**: AI-powered code quality improvements and technical debt reduction
- **Team Analytics**: DORA metrics, review turnaround time, code health dashboards
- **Deep Integrations**: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Slack, Jira, Linear

PullNova supports 30+ languages and offers a free tier for open source teams.
